info.title: Switch Assistant
info.author: ErSeraph
info.details:
Switch Assistant is a Nintendo Switch homebrew app that connects your console to Home Assistant through MQTT.

The project has two parts:

switch-ha.nro: the foreground configuration app.
Atmosphere sysmodule: the background process that publishes sensors to MQTT.
The NRO is only used to configure the app, test the connection, and install or update the bundled sysmodule. The NRO does not publish sensors while closed. The sysmodule reads the saved configuration and runs in the background after a console reboot.

changelog:
v1.8
Changelog

- Add a compact binary title index to resolve game names without loading the full title database into sysmodule memory, fixing game title detection.

v1.7
Changelog

- Update the bundled title database.

v1.6
Changelog

- Improve game detection and sleep state publishing.

v1.5
Changelog

- Add a configurable Notifications option to disable notifications if a custom Atmosphere setup is not compatible.

v1.4
Changelog

- Add live screen streaming to Home Assistant via RTSP.
- Publish a new MQTT entity with the console's RTSP stream URL for easy camera setup.

v1.3
Changelog

- Fix saved video recordings showing a green screen by excluding the notification overlay from the recording layer stack.
- Resolve the current game name from a bundled title database.
- Install the bundled title database alongside the Switch Assistant config files.

First release on 1.0
